import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivTwistFaithfulness
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyKernelIdeal
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesTensor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesMultiplicationInclusion
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Preserves.Shapes.Kernels

/-!
# The kernel of a line-bundle-twisted divisor quotient

Tensoring by a line bundle preserves kernels. For a field-valued divisor
family, the kernel of its twisted quotient is therefore the tensor product
of the pulled-back line bundle with the negative Weil-divisor module.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

namespace Modules

attribute [local instance] monoidalCategory braidedCategory

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The substrate tensor product with a line bundle preserves a kernel. -/
noncomputable def tensorObjKernelIso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : X.Modules) (hP : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial P)
    {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    tensorObj P (kernel f) ≅ kernel (tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) f) := by
  letI : (tensorLeft P).IsEquivalence :=
    (tensorLeftEquivalence P hP).isEquivalence_functor
  exact (tensorObjIso P (kernel f)).symm ≪≫
    PreservesKernel.iso (tensorLeft P) f ≪≫
    kernel.mapIso (P ◁ f) (tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) f)
      (tensorObjIso P M) (tensorObjIso P N)
      (tensorObjIso_naturality_right P f).symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Tensor preservation of kernels preserves their inclusion maps. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem tensorObjKernelIso_hom_ι {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : X.Modules) (hP : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial P)
    {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (tensorObjKernelIso P hP f).hom ≫
        kernel.ι (tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) f) =
      tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) (kernel.ι f) := by
  simp only [tensorObjKernelIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, kernel.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι, PreservesKernel.iso_hom]
  erw [kernelComparison_comp_ι_assoc]
  change (tensorObjIso P (kernel f)).inv ≫
    (P ◁ kernel.ι f) ≫ (tensorObjIso P M).hom = _
  rw [← tensorObjIso_naturality_right, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem tensorObjKernelIso_rightUnitor_ι {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : X.Modules) (hP : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial P)
    {I N : X.Modules} (f : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ N)
    (e : I ≅ kernel f) (i : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (hi : e.hom ≫ kernel.ι f = i) :
    ((tensorObjIsoOfIso (Iso.refl P) e ≪≫ tensorObjKernelIso P hP f ≪≫
      (kernelIsIsoComp (tensorObj_right_unitor P).inv
        (tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) f)).symm).hom) ≫
      kernel.ι ((tensorObj_right_unitor P).inv ≫ tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) f) =
      tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) i ≫ (tensorObj_right_unitor P).hom := by
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, kernelIsIsoComp_inv,
    kernel.lift_ι, IsIso.Iso.inv_inv]
  rw [tensorObjKernelIso_hom_ι_assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (tensorObj_right_unitor P).hom)
  change tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) e.hom ≫
    tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) (kernel.ι f) = _
  apply (cancel_epi (tensorObjIso P I).hom).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, tensorObjIso_naturality_right, Category.assoc,
    tensorObjIso_naturality_right, ← Category.assoc,
    ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp, hi, ← tensorObjIso_naturality_right]

end Modules

namespace DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance : IsIntegral (pullback π s) := fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)
noncomputable local instance : (pullback π s).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  .ofHom (pullback.snd π s)
local instance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)
local instance : LocallyOfFiniteType
    ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd π s))
local instance : QuasiCompact ((pullback π s) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
  inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (pullback.snd π s))

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The actual twisted quotient kernel is the pulled-back line bundle tensored
with the negative Weil-divisor module of the field-test family. -/
noncomputable def twistQuotientKernelIso
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L) ≅
      Modules.tensorObj ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π s)).obj L)
        (divisorModules K (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor)) := by
  let P := (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π s)).obj L
  exact (Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso (Iso.refl P)
      (asIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel) ≪≫
    Modules.tensorObjKernelIso P (hL.pullback (pullback.fst π s))
      (normalizedQuotient x) ≪≫
    (kernelIsIsoComp (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor P).inv
      (Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) (normalizedQuotient x))).symm).symm

/-! An explicit divisor-module presentation of the pulled twisting bundle
transports this kernel model to the intrinsic `O(A-D)` model.  The presentation
is an input here: local triviality alone does not provide it. -/

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
noncomputable def twistQuotientKernelIso_of_divisorIso
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (A : (pullback π s).CurveDivisor)
    (e : (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π s)).obj L ≅ divisorModules K A) :
    kernel (x.twistQuotientMap L) ≅ divisorModules K (A - x.effectiveWeilDivisor) :=
  twistQuotientKernelIso L hL x ≪≫
    Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso e (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
    divisorModulesTensorIso K A (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The inverse comparison identifies the actual twisted-kernel inclusion
with the tensor of the Weil ideal inclusion followed by the tensor unitor. -/
theorem twistQuotientKernelIso_inv_ι
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) :
    (twistQuotientKernelIso L hL x).inv ≫ kernel.ι (x.twistQuotientMap L) =
      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality
        (𝟙 ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π s)).obj L))
        x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion ≫
      (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor _).hom := by
  exact Modules.tensorObjKernelIso_rightUnitor_ι
    ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π s)).obj L) (hL.pullback (pullback.fst π s))
    (normalizedQuotient x) (asIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel)
    x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Twisting the actual field-family Cartier quotient by `O(A)` has kernel
`O(A-D)`, where `D` is the Weil divisor constructed from that family's stalks.
No identification of a kernel or of a representing scheme is assumed. -/
noncomputable def divisorTwistKernelIso
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (A : (pullback π s).CurveDivisor) :
    kernel ((Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules K A)).inv ≫
      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules K A)) (normalizedQuotient x)) ≅
      divisorModules K (A - x.effectiveWeilDivisor) := by
  let P := divisorModules K A
  let e := Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso (Iso.refl P)
      (asIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel) ≪≫
    Modules.tensorObjKernelIso P (divisorModules_isLocallyTrivial K A)
      (normalizedQuotient x) ≪≫
    (kernelIsIsoComp (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor P).inv
      (Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 P) (normalizedQuotient x))).symm
  exact e.symm ≪≫ divisorModulesTensorIso K A (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The intrinsic `O(A-D)` kernel comparison identifies its inclusion with
the canonical inclusion of bounded rational functions into `O(A)`. -/
theorem divisorTwistKernelIso_inv_ι
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)) (A : (pullback π s).CurveDivisor) :
    (divisorTwistKernelIso x A).inv ≫
        kernel.ι ((Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor (divisorModules K A)).inv ≫
          Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 (divisorModules K A)) (normalizedQuotient x)) =
      divisorModulesLE K (show A - x.effectiveWeilDivisor ≤ A from fun z => by
        have h := x.effectiveWeilDivisor_nonneg z
        change A.toFun z - x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z ≤ A.toFun z
        change 0 ≤ x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z at h
        omega) := by
  have hneg : -x.effectiveWeilDivisor ≤ 0 := fun z => by
    change -x.effectiveWeilDivisor.toFun z ≤ 0
    exact neg_nonpos.mpr (by simp)
  have he := Modules.tensorObjKernelIso_rightUnitor_ι
    (divisorModules K A) (divisorModules_isLocallyTrivial K A)
    (normalizedQuotient x) (asIso x.effectiveWeilDivisorToNormalizedKernel)
    x.effectiveWeilDivisorInclusion (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _)
  have hm := divisorModulesMul_comp_LE_of_nonpos K A hneg
  apply (cancel_epi (divisorModulesTensorIso K A (-x.effectiveWeilDivisor)).hom).mp
  simp only [divisorTwistKernelIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [divisorModulesTensorIso_hom]
  exact he.trans hm.symm

end DivFamily

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
